anchor: Find a problem. Upcycle a fix. Pitch it. Grade 5 teams invent an upcycled product, build a prototype and pitch it; the Grade 6s are the sharks who invest tokens, never buy, on Shark Tank Day, Monday 7 December. Model business all term: Pocket Pal, a hanging pocket sewn from old jeans.

lessons.title: Welcome to the Tank
lessons.focus: Week 2, homerooms, Grades 5 and 6 together. Problem to product with Locker Board, then Junk Lab in mixed teams with Grade 6 mentors. Critical feature: a product starts with a problem; upcycling makes the fix from something already made.

lessons.title: Think Like a Shark
lessons.focus: Week 3, homerooms. Buying versus investing and the four shark checks; Grade 5 teams form and shortlist three ideas with Grade 6 consultant sharks. Critical feature: sharks invest in a business that can grow, they don't buy.

lessons.title: Ask the Market
lessons.focus: Week 4, homerooms. Target market and fair survey questions, then the Token Test: Grade 6s invest tokens in each team's three ideas and teams choose one. Critical feature: choose from what the market says, not what the team likes.
